senses.gloss: m., pl. טְרָשִׁים, טְרָשִׁין (טרש I) rugged, stony ground; crags, clefts; quarry.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 103a:9">B. Bath. 103ᵃ</cite> <he>ט׳ שאמרו</he> the crags of which they speak (<he>נקעים</he> a. <he>סלעים</he> <cite ref="Bava Batra 103a:9">ib.</cite> Mish.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 1:9:4">Y. Kil. I, 27ᵇ</cite> bot.
<cite ref="Arakhin 14b:10">Arakh. 14ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 677:4">Yalk. Lev. 677</cite> <he>טְרָסִין</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23">Gen. R. s. 23</cite> <he>נעשו ט׳</he> became craggy (unarable).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 36">Lev. R. s. 36</cite> <he>ט׳ גדולים</he> large stony clods, v. <cite ref="B00916"><he>בָּלַשׁ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 4:7:2">Y. B. Bath. IV, 14ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>הט׳ המוקצין וכ׳</he> the rocks which are cut from it (the quarry).
